{{Top|leg}}
A '''perimeter sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] designed to trigger an alert if something or someone breached a designated border. [[Deke Holman]] set a perimeter sensor for the ''[[Prodigal]]'' when [[Gender/Legends|he]] rescued [[Fable Astin/Legends|Fable Astin]] from [[Trulalis]]. The sensors alerted them and [[Jaalib Brandl]] to the approach of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]].
